"""
Browser session tools for codx-junior agents.

These tools let the LLM drive the same real Chromium browser the user is
watching and controlling through the live VNC view (managed by
``BrowserManager``).  There is no separate "AI browser": user and AI share one
page, one set of cookies and one history.

The browser container also mounts the project folders under
``/home/<project_name>/<folder>`` and writes its downloads inside the project,
so the agent and the user exchange files with the project instead of being
isolated in the container.

Tools
-----
- ``start_session``      – create & start (or resume) a browser session.
- ``browse_action``      – navigate / click / fill / execute JS / read text /
                           back / forward / refresh / wait / press / select /
                           hover / scroll / links.
- ``get_screenshot``     – capture a PNG screenshot of the current page.
- ``get_source_code``    – return the current page HTML.
- ``browser_activity``   – recent user/AI actions on the session (co-browsing
                           awareness).
- ``finish_session``     – stop (default) or delete the session. Stopping keeps
                           the Chromium profile; deleting removes it too.

Settings
--------
Every tool receives ``settings`` (CODXJuniorSettings) through the
``project_settings`` injection mechanism and ``chat_id`` (from the running
SmolAgent) when its signature declares it.  All tools are ``async`` and return
:class:`ToolResponse` so the chat can render a user-facing summary while the
model receives machine-readable content.
"""

import asyncio
import logging
import time
from datetime import datetime
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional

from codx.junior.settings import CODXJuniorSettings
from .model import ToolResponse

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

#: Settings metadata applied to every browser tool in the ``TOOLS`` registry.
#: Both ``async`` and ``is_async`` keys are provided for compatibility with the
#: two conventions present in the codebase.
BROWSER_TOOL_SETTINGS: Dict[str, Any] = {
    "async": True,
    "is_async": True,
    "project_settings": True,
    "dual_response": True,
    "scope": "chat",
    # Browser state changes between calls: never serve a cached result.
    "cache": False,
}

#: Hard cap on the HTML returned by ``get_source_code`` (keeps LLM context sane).
MAX_SOURCE_CHARS = 60000
#: Hard cap on visible text returned by ``browse_action(text)``.
MAX_TEXT_CHARS = 12000


def _settings_from(kwargs: Dict[str, Any]) -> CODXJuniorSettings:
    """Extract and validate injected project settings."""
    settings: CODXJuniorSettings = kwargs.get("settings")
    if not settings:
        raise Exception("Invalid project settings")
    return settings


def _manager(settings: CODXJuniorSettings):
    """Build a BrowserManager for the given settings."""
    from codx.junior.browser.browser_manager import BrowserManager
    return BrowserManager(settings)


def _resolve_session(manager, session_id: Optional[str] = None, chat_id: Optional[str] = None):
    """Resolve a session by id, falling back to the chat's shared session."""
    session = manager.get_session(session_id) if session_id else None
    if not session and chat_id:
        session = manager.get_session_for_chat(chat_id)
    return session


def _shared_folder_lines(session) -> List[str]:
    """Describe every folder mounted in the session (empty when none)."""
    return [
        f"  - {share.name or share.folder or '/'} → {share.mount_path}"
        f"{' (read-only)' if share.readonly else ''}"
        f"  [project: {share.folder or '/'}]"
        for share in session.shared_folders
    ]


def _summary(session) -> str:
    """Build a short human-readable summary of a session."""
    folders = ", ".join(share.mount_path for share in session.shared_folders) or "(none)"
    return (
        f"session_id={session.id}\n"
        f"name={session.name or '(unnamed)'}\n"
        f"status={session.status}\n"
        f"chats={', '.join(session.chat_ids) or '(none)'}\n"
        f"live_view={session.vnc_url or '(starting)'}\n"
        f"home={session.home_path or '(not shared)'}\n"
        f"mounted_folders={folders}\n"
        f"downloads={session.downloads_mount or '(none)'} (host: {session.downloads_path or '-'})\n"
        f"current_url={session.current_url or '(blank)'}\n"
        f"current_title={session.current_title or '(blank)'}"
    )


def _sharing_note(session) -> str:
    """Describe the folder mapping for the LLM (empty when nothing is shared)."""
    if not session.shares_files():
        return ""
    lines = _shared_folder_lines(session)
    note = ""
    if lines:
        note = (
            "The browser has these project folders mounted (open them with "
            "file://<mount_path>/<file>):\n" + "\n".join(lines) + "\n"
        )
    if session.downloads_path:
        note += (
            f"Downloads are saved inside the project at '{session.downloads_path}' "
            f"(browser path '{session.downloads_mount}')."
        )
    return note.strip()


def _persist_to_chat(settings: CODXJuniorSettings, session, chat_id: Optional[str]) -> None:
    """Persist a session into its chat's meta_data (best effort)."""
    if not chat_id:
        return
    try:
        from codx.junior.chat_manager import ChatManager
        chat_manager = ChatManager(settings)
        chat = chat_manager.find_by_id(chat_id)
        if chat:
            _manager(settings).save_session_to_chat(session, chat)
            chat_manager.save_chat(chat)
    except Exception as ex:
        logger.warning("Could not persist browser session to chat %s: %s", chat_id, ex)


async def start_session(
    name: str = None,
    chat_id: str = None,
    initial_url: str = None,
    description: str = None,
    share_project: bool = None,
    share_folders: List[str] = None,
    downloads_folder: str = None,
    **kwargs,
) -> ToolResponse:
    """
    Start (or resume) a browser session connected to the current chat.

    Creates and starts an isolated Chromium container.  The returned
    ``session_id`` is used by the other browser tools, and ``live_view`` is the
    URL the user opens to watch and control the same browser.

    Project folders are mounted inside the container under
    ``/home/<project_name>/<folder>`` and every download is saved inside the
    project, so files are shared between the user, the AI and the project.

    Args:
        name: Human-readable session name (defaults to a timestamped name).
        chat_id: Associated chat id (injected by SmolAgent); used to reuse the
            chat's existing session and to make it visible in the chat UI.
        initial_url: Optional URL opened when the browser starts.
        description: Optional free-form description of the session.
        share_project: Mount the whole project at ``/home/<project_name>``.
            Omit it to mount the project root only when ``share_folders`` is
            empty.
        share_folders: Project folders to mount (``["docs", "data"]``); each one
            keeps its relative path inside ``/home/<project_name>``.
        downloads_folder: Project-relative folder receiving the downloads
            (default ``.codx/browser_downloads/<session_id>``).
        **kwargs: Injected ``settings``.

    Returns:
        ToolResponse with the session details and live-view URL.
    """
    settings = _settings_from(kwargs)
    manager = _manager(settings)

    session_name = (name or "").strip() or f"Browser {datetime.utcnow().strftime('%Y%m%d-%H%M%S')}"

    try:
        existing = manager.get_session_for_chat(chat_id) if chat_id else None
        if existing:
            if existing.status != "running":
                try:
                    existing = await asyncio.to_thread(manager.restart_session, existing.id)
                except Exception as ex:
                    logger.warning("Could not restart browser session %s: %s", existing.id, ex)

            if existing and existing.status == "running":
                return ToolResponse(
                    user_response=(
                        f"♻️ Browser session already running.\n"
                        f"[Open the live browser]({existing.vnc_url})\n"
                        f"```\n{_summary(existing)}\n```"
                    ),
                    llm_response=(
                        "A browser session is already running for this chat. "
                        f"Use this session_id in subsequent calls: {existing.id}. "
                        f"Live view: {existing.vnc_url}. "
                        f"{_sharing_note(existing)}"
                    ),
                )

        session = await asyncio.to_thread(
            manager.create_session,
            session_name,
            chat_id,
            initial_url,
            description,
            share_project,
            share_folders,
            None,
            downloads_folder,
        )
        _persist_to_chat(settings, session, chat_id)

        llm = (
            f"Browser session '{session.name}' started. session_id: {session.id}. "
            f"Live view (same browser the user sees): {session.vnc_url}. "
            "Use browse_action/get_screenshot/get_source_code/browser_activity "
            "with this session_id. Call finish_session when done. "
            f"{_sharing_note(session)}"
        )
        return ToolResponse(
            user_response=(
                f"✅ Browser session '{session.name}' ready.\n"
                f"[Open the live browser]({session.vnc_url})\n"
                f"```\n{_summary(session)}\n```"
            ),
            llm_response=llm,
        )
    except Exception as ex:
        logger.exception("start_session failed: %s", ex)
        return ToolResponse(
            user_response=f"❌ Failed to start browser session: {ex}",
            llm_response=f"Failed to start browser session: {ex}",
        )


async def browse_action(
    action: str,
    url: str = None,
    selector: str = None,
    value: str = None,
    script: str = None,
    key: str = None,
    timeout: int = 5000,
    x: int = 0,
    y: int = 0,
    session_id: str = None,
    chat_id: str = None,
    **kwargs,
) -> ToolResponse:
    """
    Perform an action on the shared browser page.

    Args:
        action: One of ``navigate``, ``click``, ``fill``, ``execute``,
            ``text``, ``links``, ``back``, ``forward``, ``refresh``, ``wait``,
            ``press``, ``select``, ``hover``, ``scroll``.
        url: Target URL (for ``navigate``).
        selector: CSS selector (for element actions).
        value: Text to fill or option to select.
        script: JavaScript to run (for ``execute``; use ``return ...``).
        key: Keyboard key for ``press``.
        timeout: Timeout in milliseconds for ``wait``.
        x: Horizontal scroll offset.
        y: Vertical scroll offset.
        session_id: Session to act on (returned by ``start_session``).
        chat_id: Alternative to ``session_id`` — resolves the chat's session.
        **kwargs: Injected ``settings``.

    Returns:
        ToolResponse with the action result, current URL and title.
    """
    settings = _settings_from(kwargs)
    manager = _manager(settings)
    session = _resolve_session(manager, session_id=session_id, chat_id=chat_id)

    if not session:
        return ToolResponse(
            user_response="❌ No browser session found. Call `start_session` first.",
            llm_response="No browser session available. Start one with start_session.",
        )
    if session.status != "running":
        # A stopped container can usually be resumed without losing the profile.
        try:
            session = await asyncio.to_thread(manager.restart_session, session.id)
        except Exception as ex:
            return ToolResponse(
                user_response=f"❌ Session is not running and could not be restarted: {ex}",
                llm_response=f"Session {session.id} is not running (status: {session.status}) and restart failed: {ex}",
            )

    action = (action or "").lower().strip()
    params = {
        key_name: value
        for key_name, value in {
            "url": url,
            "selector": selector,
            "value": value,
            "script": script,
            "key": key,
            "timeout": timeout,
            "x": x,
            "y": y,
        }.items()
        if value is not None
    }
    started_at = time.monotonic()
    browser = None
    try:
        browser = await manager.connect_browser(session)
        if action == "navigate":
            if not url:
                raise ValueError("url is required for navigate")
            title = await browser.navigate(url)
            data = f"navigated to {url}\ntitle: {title}"

        elif action == "click":
            if not selector:
                raise ValueError("selector is required for click")
            await browser.click(selector)
            data = f"clicked {selector}"

        elif action == "fill":
            if not selector or value is None:
                raise ValueError("selector and value are required for fill")
            await browser.fill(selector, value)
            data = f"filled {selector}"

        elif action == "execute":
            if not script:
                raise ValueError("script is required for execute")
            result = await browser.execute_script(script)
            data = f"script result: {result}"

        elif action in ("text", "read"):
            text = (await browser.get_text() or "").strip()
            data = f"page text:\n{text[:MAX_TEXT_CHARS]}"

        elif action == "links":
            links = await browser.get_links()
            lines = [f"- {link.get('text') or '(no text)'} → {link.get('href')}" for link in links[:200]]
            data = f"links ({len(links)}):\n" + "\n".join(lines)

        elif action == "back":
            title = await browser.go_back()
            data = f"went back\ntitle: {title}"

        elif action == "forward":
            title = await browser.go_forward()
            data = f"went forward\ntitle: {title}"

        elif action == "refresh":
            title = await browser.reload()
            data = f"page refreshed\ntitle: {title}"

        elif action == "wait":
            if not selector:
                raise ValueError("selector is required for wait")
            await browser.wait_for_selector(selector, timeout=timeout or 5000)
            data = f"element appeared: {selector}"

        elif action == "press":
            if not selector or not key:
                raise ValueError("selector and key are required for press")
            await browser.press(selector, key)
            data = f"pressed {key} on {selector}"

        elif action == "select":
            if not selector or value is None:
                raise ValueError("selector and value are required for select")
            await browser.select(selector, value)
            data = f"selected {value} on {selector}"

        elif action == "hover":
            if not selector:
                raise ValueError("selector is required for hover")
            await browser.hover(selector)
            data = f"hovered {selector}"

        elif action == "scroll":
            await browser.scroll(x=x or 0, y=y or 0)
            data = f"scrolled by x={x or 0}, y={y or 0}"

        else:
            raise ValueError(
                "unknown action '%s' (use navigate|click|fill|execute|text|links|"
                "back|forward|refresh|wait|press|select|hover|scroll)" % action
            )

        session.mark_active()
        manager.save_session(session)
        manager.log_activity(
            session,
            actor="ai",
            action=action,
            chat_id=chat_id,
            params=params,
            url=session.current_url,
            title=session.current_title,
            duration_ms=(time.monotonic() - started_at) * 1000,
            result={"message": data[:1000]},
        )
        logger.info("browse_action '%s' completed for session %s", action, session.id[:8])

        return ToolResponse(
            user_response=(
                f"✅ `{action}` done on session {session.id[:8]}.\n\n{data}\n\n"
                f"URL: {session.current_url or '(blank)'}\nTitle: {session.current_title or '(blank)'}"
            ),
            llm_response=(
                f"Action '{action}' on session {session.id} succeeded.\n{data}\n"
                f"URL: {session.current_url or '(blank)'}\nTitle: {session.current_title or '(blank)'}"
            ),
        )
    except Exception as ex:
        logger.exception("browse_action failed: %s", ex)
        manager.log_activity(
            session,
            actor="ai",
            action=action or "unknown",
            chat_id=chat_id,
            params=params,
            success=False,
            error=str(ex),
            duration_ms=(time.monotonic() - started_at) * 1000,
        )
        return ToolResponse(
            user_response=f"❌ `{action}` failed: {ex}",
            llm_response=f"Action '{action}' on session {session.id} failed: {ex}",
        )
    finally:
        if browser is not None:
            await browser.close()


async def get_screenshot(
    session_id: str = None,
    chat_id: str = None,
    full_page: bool = True,
    **kwargs,
) -> ToolResponse:
    """
    Take a screenshot of the current page.

    Args:
        session_id: Session to capture (or ``chat_id`` to resolve it).
        chat_id: Alternative to ``session_id``.
        full_page: Capture the whole scrollable page (default) or the viewport.
        **kwargs: Injected ``settings``.

    Returns:
        ToolResponse whose ``user_response`` embeds the PNG image.
    """
    settings = _settings_from(kwargs)
    manager = _manager(settings)
    session = _resolve_session(manager, session_id=session_id, chat_id=chat_id)

    if not session or session.status != "running":
        return ToolResponse(
            user_response="❌ No running browser session (call `start_session` first).",
            llm_response="No running browser session available for screenshot.",
        )

    started_at = time.monotonic()
    browser = None
    try:
        browser = await manager.connect_browser(session)
        data_uri = await browser.get_screenshot(full_page=full_page)
        session.mark_active()
        manager.save_session(session)
        manager.log_activity(
            session,
            actor="ai",
            action="screenshot",
            chat_id=chat_id,
            params={"full_page": bool(full_page)},
            url=session.current_url,
            title=session.current_title,
            duration_ms=(time.monotonic() - started_at) * 1000,
        )
        return ToolResponse(
            user_response=f"📸 Screenshot of session {session.id[:8]}:\n\n![screenshot]({data_uri})",
            llm_response=(
                f"Screenshot captured for session {session.id} "
                f"(url: {session.current_url or '(blank)'}, title: {session.current_title or '(blank)'})."
            ),
        )
    except Exception as ex:
        logger.exception("get_screenshot failed: %s", ex)
        manager.log_activity(
            session, actor="ai", action="screenshot", chat_id=chat_id,
            success=False, error=str(ex),
            duration_ms=(time.monotonic() - started_at) * 1000,
        )
        return ToolResponse(
            user_response=f"❌ Screenshot failed: {ex}",
            llm_response=f"Screenshot failed for session {session.id}: {ex}",
        )
    finally:
        if browser is not None:
            await browser.close()


async def get_source_code(
    session_id: str = None,
    chat_id: str = None,
    **kwargs,
) -> ToolResponse:
    """
    Return the current page HTML source.

    Args:
        session_id: Session to read (or ``chat_id`` to resolve it).
        chat_id: Alternative to ``session_id``.
        **kwargs: Injected ``settings``.

    Returns:
        ToolResponse with the (truncated) HTML.
    """
    settings = _settings_from(kwargs)
    manager = _manager(settings)
    session = _resolve_session(manager, session_id=session_id, chat_id=chat_id)

    if not session or session.status != "running":
        return ToolResponse(
            user_response="❌ No running browser session (call `start_session` first).",
            llm_response="No running browser session available for source retrieval.",
        )

    started_at = time.monotonic()
    browser = None
    try:
        browser = await manager.connect_browser(session)
        html = await browser.get_content()
        truncated = (html or "")[:MAX_SOURCE_CHARS]
        session.mark_active()
        manager.save_session(session)
        manager.log_activity(
            session,
            actor="ai",
            action="source",
            chat_id=chat_id,
            url=session.current_url,
            title=session.current_title,
            duration_ms=(time.monotonic() - started_at) * 1000,
            result={"chars": len(html or "")},
        )
        return ToolResponse(
            user_response=(
                f"📄 Source of session {session.id[:8]} "
                f"(url: {session.current_url}, title: {session.current_title}):\n"
                f"```html\n{truncated}\n```"
            ),
            llm_response=(
                f"HTML source for session {session.id} "
                f"(url: {session.current_url}, title: {session.current_title}):\n{truncated}"
            ),
        )
    except Exception as ex:
        logger.exception("get_source_code failed: %s", ex)
        manager.log_activity(
            session, actor="ai", action="source", chat_id=chat_id,
            success=False, error=str(ex),
            duration_ms=(time.monotonic() - started_at) * 1000,
        )
        return ToolResponse(
            user_response=f"❌ Failed to read source: {ex}",
            llm_response=f"Source retrieval failed for session {session.id}: {ex}",
        )
    finally:
        if browser is not None:
            await browser.close()


async def browser_activity(
    session_id: str = None,
    chat_id: str = None,
    limit: int = 30,
    **kwargs,
) -> ToolResponse:
    """
    Return the recent user/AI actions on the shared browser session.

    This lets the agent notice what the user did between tool calls (the user
    can click/type/navigate directly in the live view).  It is also the audit
    trail required for co-browsing.
    """
    settings = _settings_from(kwargs)
    manager = _manager(settings)
    session = _resolve_session(manager, session_id=session_id, chat_id=chat_id)

    if not session:
        return ToolResponse(
            user_response="❌ No browser session found.",
            llm_response="No browser session available. Start one with start_session.",
        )

    entries = manager.get_activity(session.id, limit=limit)
    if not entries:
        return ToolResponse(
            user_response=f"🧾 No activity recorded yet for session {session.id[:8]}.",
            llm_response=f"No activity recorded for session {session.id}.",
        )

    lines = []
    for entry in entries:
        actor = entry.get("actor") or "?"
        action = entry.get("action") or "?"
        status = "ok" if entry.get("success", True) else "error"
        url = entry.get("url") or ""
        lines.append(f"- [{entry.get('ts')}] {actor}: {action} ({status}) {url}".rstrip())
    text = "\n".join(lines)
    return ToolResponse(
        user_response=f"🧾 Recent activity for session {session.id[:8]}:\n{text}",
        llm_response=f"Recent activity for session {session.id}:\n{text}",
    )


async def finish_session(
    session_id: str = None,
    chat_id: str = None,
    delete: bool = False,
    **kwargs,
) -> ToolResponse:
    """
    Finish a browser session. Stopping keeps its profile; deleting removes it.

    Args:
        session_id: Session to finish (or ``chat_id`` to resolve it).
        chat_id: Alternative to ``session_id``.
        delete: When True the container is removed and the session folder
            (including its Chromium profile) is deleted. When False (default)
            the container is only stopped and the profile is preserved for a
            later restart.
        **kwargs: Injected ``settings``.

    Returns:
        ToolResponse with the finish result.
    """
    settings = _settings_from(kwargs)
    manager = _manager(settings)
    session = _resolve_session(manager, session_id=session_id, chat_id=chat_id)

    if not session:
        return ToolResponse(
            user_response="❌ No browser session found to finish.",
            llm_response="No browser session found to finish.",
        )

    try:
        if delete:
            await asyncio.to_thread(manager.delete_session, session.id)
            verb = "deleted"
        else:
            await asyncio.to_thread(manager.stop_session, session.id)
            verb = "stopped"

        logger.info("finish_session: %s session %s", verb, session.id[:8])
        return ToolResponse(
            user_response=f"🧹 Browser session {session.id[:8]} {verb}.",
            llm_response=(
                f"Browser session {session.id} {verb}. "
                + ("Profile preserved." if not delete else "Profile deleted with the session.")
                + (
                    f" Downloaded files stay in the project at '{session.downloads_path}'."
                    if session.downloads_path else ""
                )
            ),
        )
    except Exception as ex:
        logger.exception("finish_session failed: %s", ex)
        return ToolResponse(
            user_response=f"❌ Failed to finish session: {ex}",
            llm_response=f"Failed to finish session {session.id}: {ex}",
        )

"""
Browser Session REST API Router

Handles CRUD operations for browser sessions with full async support.

REST Endpoints:
    GET    /api/browsers              - List all sessions
    POST   /api/browsers              - Create new session
    GET    /api/browsers/<session_id> - Get session details
    PUT    /api/browsers/<session_id> - Rename session
    DELETE /api/browsers/<session_id> - Stop & delete session
    POST   /api/browsers/<session_id>/action     - Execute browser action
    POST   /api/browsers/<session_id>/screenshot - Take screenshot
    GET    /api/browsers/<session_id>/source     - Get page source
    GET    /api/browsers/<session_id>/activity   - User/AI audit trail
    GET    /api/browsers/<session_id>/cost       - AI cost/usage summary
    POST   /api/browsers/<session_id>/restart    - Restart session
    POST   /api/browsers/<session_id>/stop       - Stop session (keep container)

Socket.IO Events (real-time status updates for long-running operations):
    codx-junior-browser-create   - Create session with progress
    codx-junior-browser-delete   - Delete session with progress
    codx-junior-browser-restart  - Restart session with progress
    codx-junior-browser-stop     - Stop session with progress

    Emits: codx-junior-browser-status with {status, session_id, message, error, session}

Project folders (see ``codx/junior/api/browser_files.py``):
    GET    /api/browsers/<session_id>/files      - Folder mapping + downloads
"""

import logging
import time
from typing import Any, Dict, Optional

from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException, Request, status

from codx.junior.engine.session import CODXJuniorSession
from codx.junior.sio.sio import sio, sio_api_endpoint
from codx.junior.sio.session_channel import SessionChannel
from codx.junior.api.browser_models import (
    BrowserSessionResponse,
    BrowserSessionListResponse,
    BrowserSessionCreateRequest,
    BrowserSessionUpdateRequest,
    BrowserSessionChatRequest,
    BrowserSessionChatResponse,
    BrowserSessionActionRequest,
    BrowserActionResponse,
    BrowserScreenshotResponse,
    BrowserSourceResponse,
    BrowserActivityResponse,
    BrowserCostResponse,
    BrowserScreenshotRequest,
)
from codx.junior.chat_manager import ChatManager

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

router = APIRouter(prefix="/browsers", tags=["browser"])

BROWSER_STATUS_EVENT = "codx-junior-browser-status"

# ============================================================================
# Helpers
# ============================================================================

async def get_session_context(request: Request) -> CODXJuniorSession:
    """Dependency: get the current session context from request state."""
    session = getattr(request.state, 'codx_junior_session', None)
    if not session:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
            detail="No active session",
        )
    return session


def _browser_manager(session: CODXJuniorSession):
    """
    Return a BrowserManager for the session.

    Reuses ``session.browser_manager`` when present so a long-lived manager can
    be injected, otherwise constructs one from the project settings.
    """
    manager = getattr(session, "browser_manager", None)
    if manager:
        return manager
    from codx.junior.browser.browser_manager import BrowserManager
    return BrowserManager(session.settings)


def _emit(channel: SessionChannel, payload: dict) -> None:
    """Send a browser status event (keeps the ts-stamping in one place)."""
    channel.send_event(BROWSER_STATUS_EVENT, payload)


# ============================================================================
# REST Endpoints
# ============================================================================

@router.get(
    "",
    response_model=BrowserSessionListResponse,
    summary="List all browser sessions",
    responses={
        200: {"description": "List of browser sessions"},
        401: {"description": "Unauthorized"},
        500: {"description": "Server error"},
    },
)
async def list_sessions(request: Request):
    """List all browser sessions for the current project."""
    try:
        session = await get_session_context(request)
        browser_manager = _browser_manager(session)

        sessions = browser_manager.list_sessions()
        responses = [BrowserSessionResponse(**s.to_dict()) for s in sessions]
        logger.info("list_sessions: returned %d browser sessions", len(sessions))
        return BrowserSessionListResponse(count=len(responses), sessions=responses)
    except HTTPException:
        raise
    except Exception as e:
        logger.exception("list_sessions: unexpected error: %s", e)
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=str(e))


@router.post(
    "",
    response_model=BrowserSessionResponse,
    status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED,
    summary="Create a new browser session",
    responses={
        201: {"description": "Session created"},
        400: {"description": "Invalid request (unknown project folder)"},
        401: {"description": "Unauthorized"},
        500: {"description": "Server error"},
    },
)
async def create_session(request: Request, req: BrowserSessionCreateRequest):
    """
    Create and start a new browser session.

    Starts a Chromium Docker container with Traefik routing and a persistent profile.
    The session is named (``req.name``) and optionally connected to ``req.chat_id``.
    Multiple chats may connect to the same session.

    Project folders listed in ``req.share_folders`` are mounted inside the
    container under ``/home/<project_name>/<folder>``; ``req.downloads_folder``
    selects the project folder receiving the browser downloads.
    """
    try:
        session = await get_session_context(request)
        browser_manager = _browser_manager(session)

        chat = None
        chat_manager = None
        if req.chat_id:
            chat_manager = ChatManager(session.settings)
            chat = chat_manager.find_by_id(req.chat_id)
            if not chat:
                logger.error("create_session: chat not found: %s", req.chat_id)
                raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Chat not found")

        browser_session = browser_manager.create_session(
            name=req.name,
            chat_id=req.chat_id,
            initial_url=req.initial_url,
            description=req.description,
            share_project=req.share_project,
            share_folders=req.share_folders,
            readonly=req.readonly,
            downloads_folder=req.downloads_folder,
            downloads_mount=req.downloads_mount,
        )

        if chat and chat_manager:
            browser_manager.save_session_to_chat(browser_session, chat)
            chat_manager.save_chat(chat)

        logger.info(
            "create_session: created browser session %s ('%s') for chat %s with %d shared folder(s)",
            browser_session.id[:8],
            browser_session.name,
            req.chat_id,
            len(browser_session.shared_folders),
        )
        return BrowserSessionResponse(**browser_session.to_dict())

    except HTTPException:
        raise
    except ValueError as e:
        logger.error("create_session: invalid share configuration: %s", e)
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(e))
    except Exception as e:
        logger.exception("create_session: unexpected error: %s", e)
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=str(e))


@router.get(
    "/{session_id}",
    response_model=BrowserSessionResponse,
    summary="Get session details",
    responses={
        200: {"description": "Session details"},
        401: {"description": "Unauthorized"},
        404: {"description": "Session not found"},
        500: {"description": "Server error"},
    },
)
async def get_session(request: Request, session_id: str):
    """Get details for a specific browser session."""
    try:
        session = await get_session_context(request)
        browser_manager = _browser_manager(session)

        browser_session = browser_manager.get_session(session_id)
        if not browser_session:
            logger.error("get_session: session not found: %s", session_id)
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Session not found")

        logger.info("get_session: retrieved session %s", session_id[:8])
        return BrowserSessionResponse(**browser_session.to_dict())

    except HTTPException:
        raise
    except Exception as e:
        logger.exception("get_session: unexpected error: %s", e)
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=str(e))


@router.put(
    "/{session_id}",
    response_model=BrowserSessionResponse,
    summary="Update a browser session",
    responses={
        200: {"description": "Session updated"},
        401: {"description": "Unauthorized"},
        404: {"description": "Session not found"},
        500: {"description": "Server error"},
    },
)
async def update_session(request: Request, session_id: str, req: BrowserSessionUpdateRequest):
    """Update the human-readable name of a browser session."""
    try:
        session = await get_session_context(request)
        browser_manager = _browser_manager(session)
        browser_session = browser_manager.update_session(session_id, name=req.name)
        if not browser_session:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Session not found")
        return BrowserSessionResponse(**browser_session.to_dict())
    except HTTPException:
        raise
    except Exception as e:
        logger.exception("update_session: unexpected error: %s", e)
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=str(e))


@router.post(
    "/{session_id}/chat",
    response_model=BrowserSessionChatResponse,
    summary="Open or create the chat linked to a session",
    responses={
        200: {"description": "Chat linked to the session"},
        401: {"description": "Unauthorized"},
        404: {"description": "Session or chat not found"},
        500: {"description": "Server error"},
    },
)
async def open_session_chat(
    request: Request,
    session_id: str,
    req: Optional[BrowserSessionChatRequest] = None,
):
    """
    Return a chat that can drive the browser session from the session view.

    If the session already has a linked chat, that chat is reused. If it has
    none (or the caller passes a different ``chat_id``), a chat is created and
    linked to the session. Chats opened this way get the built-in ``browser``
    profile so the agent receives the browser tools.
    """
    from codx.junior.db import Chat

    try:
        session = await get_session_context(request)
        browser_manager = _browser_manager(session)
        browser_session = browser_manager.get_session(session_id)
        if not browser_session:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Session not found")

        chat_manager = ChatManager(session.settings)
        chat = None

        requested_chat_id = req.chat_id if req else None
        create_new = bool(req.create_new) if req else False
        if requested_chat_id:
            chat = chat_manager.find_by_id(requested_chat_id)
            if not chat:
                raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Chat not found")
        elif not create_new and browser_session.chat_ids:
            chat = chat_manager.find_by_id(browser_session.chat_ids[0])

        browser_profile_available = False
        try:
            browser_profile_available = bool(
                session.get_profile_manager().get_profiles_by_name(["browser"])
            )
        except Exception as ex:
            logger.debug("Could not check the browser profile: %s", ex)

        if not chat:
            base_name = f"Browser: {browser_session.name or browser_session.id[:8]}"
            suffix = f" ({len(browser_session.chat_ids) + 1})" if browser_session.chat_ids else ""
            chat = Chat(
                name=f"{base_name}{suffix}",
                mode="chat",
                project_id=session.settings.project_id,
                owner_project_id=session.settings.project_id,
                profiles=["browser"] if browser_profile_available else [],
                meta_data={},
            )
            chat_manager.save_chat(chat)

        # The chat explicitly asks to operate this browser: make sure the
        # browser profile (and therefore the browser tools) is active.
        if browser_profile_available and "browser" not in (chat.profiles or []):
            chat.profiles = [*(chat.profiles or []), "browser"]

        browser_manager.save_session_to_chat(browser_session, chat)
        chat_manager.save_chat(chat)
        logger.info(
            "open_session_chat: session %s linked to chat %s",
            session_id[:8], chat.id,
        )
        return BrowserSessionChatResponse(
            session=BrowserSessionResponse(**browser_session.to_dict()),
            chat=chat.model_dump(),
        )

    except HTTPException:
        raise
    except Exception as e:
        logger.exception("open_session_chat: unexpected error: %s", e)
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=str(e))


@router.delete(
    "/{session_id}",
    status_code=status.HTTP_204_NO_CONTENT,
    summary="Stop and delete a session",
    responses={
        204: {"description": "Session deleted"},
        401: {"description": "Unauthorized"},
        404: {"description": "Session not found"},
        500: {"description": "Server error"},
    },
)
async def delete_session(request: Request, session_id: str):
    """Stop the Docker container and delete a browser session."""
    try:
        session = await get_session_context(request)
        browser_manager = _browser_manager(session)

        browser_session = browser_manager.get_session(session_id)
        if not browser_session:
            logger.error("delete_session: session not found: %s", session_id)
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Session not found")

        browser_manager.delete_session(session_id)
        logger.info("delete_session: deleted session %s", session_id[:8])

    except HTTPException:
        raise
    except Exception as e:
        logger.exception("delete_session: unexpected error: %s", e)
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=str(e))


@router.post(
    "/{session_id}/restart",
    response_model=BrowserSessionResponse,
    summary="Restart a stopped session",
    responses={
        200: {"description": "Session restarted"},
        401: {"description": "Unauthorized"},
        404: {"description": "Session not found"},
        500: {"description": "Server error"},
    },
)
async def restart_session(request: Request, session_id: str):
    """Restart a stopped browser session (preserves the Chromium profile)."""
    try:
        session = await get_session_context(request)

@router.post(
    "/{session_id}/action",
    response_model=BrowserActionResponse,
    summary="Execute a browser action",
    responses={
        200: {"description": "Action executed"},
        400: {"description": "Invalid action or session not running"},
        401: {"description": "Unauthorized"},
        404: {"description": "Session not found"},
        500: {"description": "Server error"},
    },
)
async def execute_action(request: Request, session_id: str, req: BrowserSessionActionRequest):
    """
    Execute a browser action on the shared page.

    The action is performed through the same CDP connection the AI uses, so the
    user's live VNC view reflects it immediately.
    """
    browser = None
    browser_manager = None
    browser_session = None
    action = (req.action or "").lower().strip()
    started_at = time.monotonic()
    params: Dict[str, Any] = {
        key: value
        for key, value in {
            "url": req.url,
            "selector": req.selector,
            "value": req.value,
            "script": req.script,
            "key": req.key,
            "timeout": req.timeout,
            "x": req.x,
            "y": req.y,
            "full_page": req.full_page,
        }.items()
        if value is not None
    }
    title = None

    try:
        session = await get_session_context(request)
        browser_manager = _browser_manager(session)

        browser_session = browser_manager.get_session(session_id)
        if not browser_session:
            logger.error("execute_action: session not found: %s", session_id)
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Session not found")

        if browser_session.status != "running":
            logger.error(
                "execute_action: session not running: %s (status=%s)",
                session_id, browser_session.status,
            )
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=400,
                detail=f"Session not running (status: {browser_session.status})",
            )

        browser = await browser_manager.connect_browser(browser_session)

        if action == "navigate":
            if not req.url:
                raise HTTPException(400, "URL required for navigate action")
            title = await browser.navigate(req.url)
            message, data = f"Navigated to {req.url}", {"title": title, "url": req.url}

        elif action == "click":
            if not req.selector:
                raise HTTPException(400, "Selector required for click action")
            await browser.click(req.selector)
            message, data = f"Clicked {req.selector}", {"selector": req.selector}

        elif action == "fill":
            if not req.selector or req.value is None:
                raise HTTPException(400, "Selector and value required for fill action")
            await browser.fill(req.selector, req.value)
            message, data = f"Filled {req.selector}", {"selector": req.selector, "value": req.value}

        elif action == "execute":
            if not req.script:
                raise HTTPException(400, "Script required for execute action")
            result = await browser.execute_script(req.script)
            message, data = "Script executed", {"result": result}

        elif action == "text" or action == "read":
            text = await browser.get_text()
            message, data = "Page text read", {"text": text}

        elif action == "links":
            links = await browser.get_links()
            message, data = "Page links read", {"links": links}

        elif action == "back":
            title = await browser.go_back()
            message, data = "Navigated back", {"title": title}

        elif action == "forward":
            title = await browser.go_forward()
            message, data = "Navigated forward", {"title": title}

        elif action == "refresh":
            title = await browser.reload()
            message, data = "Page refreshed", {"title": title}

        elif action == "wait":
            if not req.selector:
                raise HTTPException(400, "Selector required for wait action")
            await browser.wait_for_selector(req.selector, timeout=req.timeout or 5000)
            message, data = f"Element appeared: {req.selector}", {"selector": req.selector}

        elif action == "press":
            if not req.selector or not req.key:
                raise HTTPException(400, "Selector and key required for press action")
            await browser.press(req.selector, req.key)
            message, data = f"Pressed {req.key} on {req.selector}", {"selector": req.selector, "key": req.key}

        elif action == "select":
            if not req.selector or req.value is None:
                raise HTTPException(400, "Selector and value required for select action")
            await browser.select(req.selector, req.value)
            message, data = f"Selected {req.value} on {req.selector}", {"selector": req.selector, "value": req.value}

        elif action == "hover":
            if not req.selector:
                raise HTTPException(400, "Selector required for hover action")
            await browser.hover(req.selector)
            message, data = f"Hovered {req.selector}", {"selector": req.selector}

        elif action == "scroll":
            await browser.scroll(x=req.x or 0, y=req.y or 0)
            message, data = "Page scrolled", {"x": req.x or 0, "y": req.y or 0}

        elif action == "screenshot":
            screenshot = await browser.get_screenshot(full_page=bool(req.full_page))
            message, data = "Screenshot captured", {"screenshot": screenshot, "full_page": bool(req.full_page)}

        else:
            raise HTTPException(400, f"Unknown action: {req.action}")

        data.update({
            "url": browser_session.current_url,
            "title": browser_session.current_title,
        })
        browser_manager.save_session(browser_session)
        browser_manager.log_activity(
            browser_session,
            actor="user",
            action=action,
            params=params,
            url=browser_session.current_url,
            title=browser_session.current_title,
            duration_ms=(time.monotonic() - started_at) * 1000,
            result={"message": message},
        )
        logger.info("execute_action: '%s' completed for session %s", action, session_id[:8])
        return BrowserActionResponse(success=True, message=message, data=data)

    except HTTPException as ex:
        if browser_session is not None and browser_manager is not None:
            browser_manager.log_activity(
                browser_session,
                actor="user",
                action=action or "unknown",
                params=params,
                success=False,
                error=str(ex.detail),
                duration_ms=(time.monotonic() - started_at) * 1000,
            )
        raise
    except Exception as e:
        logger.exception("execute_action: unexpected error: %s", e)
        if browser_session is not None and browser_manager is not None:
            browser_manager.log_activity(
                browser_session,
                actor="user",
                action=action or "unknown",
                params=params,
                success=False,
                error=str(e),
                duration_ms=(time.monotonic() - started_at) * 1000,
            )
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=str(e))
    finally:
        if browser is not None:
            await browser.close()

    """
    Create a new browser session via Socket.IO, emitting status updates.

    Request data: ``name`` (str, required) · ``chat_id`` (str, optional) ·
    ``share_project`` (bool, optional) · ``share_folders`` (list, optional) ·
    ``downloads_folder`` (str, optional) · ``codx_path`` (str, injected by the client).
    Emits: ``codx-junior-browser-status`` {status, session_id, message, error, session}.

    channel = SessionChannel(sio=sio, sid=sid)
    chat_id = data.get("chat_id")

    initial_url = data.get("initial_url")

    readonly = data.get("readonly")
    downloads_folder = data.get("downloads_folder")
    downloads_mount = data.get("downloads_mount")

    if not codxjunior_session:
        _emit(channel, {"status": "error", "message": "Missing codx_path", "error": "Missing codx_path"})
        return
    if not name:
        _emit(channel, {"status": "error", "message": "name is required", "error": "Missing name"})
        return

    try:
        chat = None
        if chat_id:
            chat_manager = ChatManager(codxjunior_session.settings)
            chat = chat_manager.find_by_id(chat_id)
            if not chat:
                _emit(channel, {"status": "error", "message": "Chat not found", "error": f"Chat {chat_id} not found"})
                return

        _emit(channel, {"status": "starting", "message": "Creating browser session...", "name": name, "chat_id": chat_id})

        browser_manager = codxjunior_session.get_browser_manager()
        browser_session = browser_manager.create_session(
            name=name,
            chat_id=chat_id,
            initial_url=initial_url,
            description=description,
            share_project=share_project,
            share_folders=share_folders,
            readonly=readonly,
            downloads_folder=downloads_folder,
            downloads_mount=downloads_mount,
        )

        _emit(channel, {
            "status": "created",
            "session_id": browser_session.id,
            "name": browser_session.name,
            "message": f"Browser session '{browser_session.name}' ({browser_session.id[:8]}) created",
            "session": browser_session.to_dict(),
        })

        if chat:
            browser_manager.save_session_to_chat(browser_session, chat)
            ChatManager(codxjunior_session.settings).save_chat(chat)

        _emit(channel, {
            "status": "ready",
            "session_id": browser_session.id,
            "name": browser_session.name,
            "message": "Browser session ready",
            "session": browser_session.to_dict(),
        })
        logger.info("sio_browser_create: created session %s for chat %s", browser_session.id[:8], chat_id)

    except Exception as e:
        logger.exception("sio_browser_create: unexpected error: %s", e)
        _emit(channel, {"status": "error", "message": "Failed to create browser session", "error": str(e)})

# Browser sessions: sharing project folders

Browser sessions run their own Chromium container: a live VNC view for the user
and a CDP endpoint for the AI, so both drive the same page. Files used to stay
outside the project — downloads lived in the session folder and the page could
not see anything from the repository.

Sessions now **map any number of project folders** into the container and write
the browser downloads inside the project.

## Mount layout

Every folder is mounted under a single tree, `/home/<project_name>/`, keeping the
project structure:

| Selected folder | Host folder | Container path |
|---|---|---|
| *(project root)* | `<project>` | `/home/<project>` |
| `docs` | `<project>/docs` | `/home/<project>/docs` |
| `docs/api` | `<project>/docs/api` | `/home/<project>/docs/api` |
| downloads (default) | `<project>/.codx/browser_downloads/<session_id>` | `/downloads` or, when inside a mounted folder, `/home/<project>/.codx/browser_downloads/<session_id>` |

`<project_name>` is the sanitized project name (`My Project` → `My-Project`) and
the tree root is configurable with `CODX_BROWSER_HOME_ROOT` (default `/home`).

Rules enforced by `DockerBrowserManager.configure_share`:

- listing `share_folders` **never** mounts the project root implicitly; ask for
  it with `share_project=True` (the default when no folder is listed);
- mounting the root makes nested entries redundant, so they are skipped;
- each folder carries its own `readonly` flag;
- a folder must exist and stay inside the project (`../` raises `ValueError`);
- at most `MAX_SHARED_FOLDERS` (20) folders per session.

## Downloads

The downloads folder is a project folder chosen by `downloads_folder`
(project-relative, default `.codx/browser_downloads/<session_id>`):

- **inside a mounted, writable folder** → no extra bind; the browser writes to
  `/home/<project>/docs/downloads` (same tree the user and the AI browse);
- **outside every mount** → dedicated bind at `/downloads`;
- `downloads_mount` forces a dedicated bind at a chosen container path.

Downloads are applied through CDP (`Browser.setDownloadBehavior`) on **every**
connection in `BrowserManager.connect_browser`, because it is browser-wide state
and must cover both the user clicking a link in the live view and the AI
triggering a download. It is best effort: a failure logs a warning.

With `share_project=False` and no project folder available, downloads fall back
to `.codx/browser_sessions/<session_id>/downloads/` (the previous behaviour).

## Usage

### Agent tool

```python
start_session(
    name="Invoice hunt",
    share_folders=["docs", "data"],   # -> /home/<project>/docs, /home/<project>/data
    downloads_folder="data/downloads", # downloads land inside the mounted data folder
)
```

The tool response lists every mount and the downloads path, so the model knows
which `file://` URLs it can open and where the saved files are.

### REST / Socket.IO

`POST /api/browsers` and `codx-junior-browser-create` accept the same options:

```json
{
  "name": "Invoice hunt",
  "share_project": false,
  "share_folders": [
    "docs",
    { "folder": "data", "name": "Data", "readonly": true, "mount_path": "/work/data" }
  ],
  "downloads_folder": "docs/downloads"
}
```

`GET /api/browsers/{session_id}/files?limit=200` returns the mapping and the
saved files:

```json
{
  "session_id": "…",
  "project_name": "codx-api",
  "home_path": "/home/codx-api",
  "folders": [
    { "name": "docs", "folder": "docs", "host_path": "/repo/codx-api/docs",
      "mount_path": "/home/codx-api/docs", "readonly": false }
  ],
  "downloads_path": "/repo/codx-api/docs/downloads",
  "downloads_folder": "docs/downloads",
  "downloads_mount": "/home/codx-api/docs/downloads",
  "downloads_own_mount": false,
  "count": 1,
  "files": [
    { "name": "invoice.pdf", "relative_path": "invoice.pdf",
      "path": "docs/downloads/invoice.pdf",
      "container_path": "/home/codx-api/docs/downloads/invoice.pdf",
      "size": 48213, "modified_at": "2023-10-01T12:00:00" }
  ]
}
```

`path` is project-relative (immediately readable with the project file tools)
and `container_path` is what the page uses.

## Configuration

| Variable | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `CODX_BROWSER_SHARE_PROJECT` | `1` | Allow mounting project folders. `0` disables it for the instance. |
| `CODX_BROWSER_HOME_ROOT` | `/home` | Container root of the project tree. |

Session arguments (`BrowserManager.create_session`):

| Argument | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `share_project` | `None` | Mount the project root; `None` = only when no folder is listed. |
| `share_folders` | `None` | Folders to mount (strings or objects with folder/name/mount_path/readonly). |
| `readonly` | `None` | Mount the listed folders `:ro` (per-folder flag wins). |
| `downloads_folder` | `.codx/browser_downloads/<session_id>` | Project folder receiving the downloads. |
| `downloads_mount` | `None` | Force a dedicated downloads bind (default `/downloads`). |

Sessions created before this feature keep their persisted mapping and are never
upgraded implicitly: recreate the session to pick up the new layout.

## Implementation map

| File | Role |
|---|---|
| `codx/junior/browser/model.py` | `SharedFolder`, `shared_folders`, downloads fields, path helpers. |
| `codx/junior/browser/docker_browser_manager.py` | `configure_share` (many folders + downloads), `_build_share_mounts`, `-v` flags. |
| `codx/junior/browser/browser_manager.py` | Share options on `create_session`, CDP download path, `get_shared_paths`/`get_shared_files`. |
| `codx/junior/api/browser_models.py` | `BrowserSharedFolder` and the shared-files response models. |
| `codx/junior/api/browser_files.py` | `GET /api/browsers/{id}/files` (router auto-discovered). |
| `codx/junior/api/browser.py` | REST + Socket.IO create forward the share options. |
| `codx/junior/tools/browser_tools.py` | `start_session(share_project, share_folders, downloads_folder)` and the mount summary. |

"""
Browser activity log — append-only audit trail for co-browsing sessions.

Every action performed on a browser session is written as one JSON object per
line to::

    .codx/browser_sessions/<session_id>/activity.jsonl

Both actors are recorded:

* ``ai``   – a tool call executed by SmolAgent (or another agent).
* ``user`` – an action sent from the web UI / REST API.
* ``system`` – lifecycle events (create / stop / restart / delete / errors).

The log is intentionally independent from the AI analytics store: analytics
tracks LLM token usage and cost, while this file answers "what happened in this
browser, when, and who did it".  The API exposes it through
``GET /api/browsers/{id}/activity`` and joins it with the AI cost of every chat
connected to the session in ``GET /api/browsers/{id}/cost``.
"""

import json
import logging
import os
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

ACTIVITY_FILE = "activity.jsonl"
MAX_READ_LINES = 2000


def _now() -> str:
    """Return a timezone-aware ISO timestamp."""
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()


class BrowserActivityLog:
    """Append-only per-session activity log."""

    def __init__(self, session_folder: str):
        """
        Args:
            session_folder: Folder that owns the ``activity.jsonl`` file.
        """
        self.session_folder = session_folder
        self.path = os.path.join(session_folder, ACTIVITY_FILE)

    def record(
        self,
        *,
        actor: str,
        action: str,
        success: bool = True,
        session_id: Optional[str] = None,
        chat_id: Optional[str] = None,
        params: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
        url: Optional[str] = None,
        title: Optional[str] = None,
        duration_ms: Optional[float] = None,
        error: Optional[str] = None,
        result: Any = None,
    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """
        Append one activity entry.

        The method is best-effort: logging failures are reported but never
        break a browser action.

        Returns:
            The entry that was written.
        """
        entry: Dict[str, Any] = {
            "ts": _now(),
            "session_id": session_id,
            "chat_id": chat_id,
            "actor": actor or "system",
            "action": action,
            "success": bool(success),
            "params": _safe_params(params),
            "url": url,
            "title": title,
            "duration_ms": round(float(duration_ms), 2) if duration_ms is not None else None,
            "error": error,
        }
        if result is not None:
            try:
                serialized = json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, default=str)
            except Exception:
                serialized = str(result)
            entry["result"] = serialized[:4000]

        try:
            os.makedirs(self.session_folder, exist_ok=True)
            with open(self.path, "a", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
                handle.write(json.dumps(entry, ensure_ascii=False, default=str) + "\n")
        except Exception as ex:
            logger.warning("Could not write browser activity log '%s': %s", self.path, ex)
        return entry

    def read(self, limit: int = 100) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
        """
        Return the most recent *limit* entries (oldest → newest).

        Large logs are read tail-first so activity endpoints stay cheap.
        """
        if not os.path.isfile(self.path):
            return []
        try:
            with open(self.path, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as handle:
                lines = handle.readlines()[-max(1, min(int(limit), MAX_READ_LINES)):]
        except Exception as ex:
            logger.warning("Could not read browser activity log '%s': %s", self.path, ex)
            return []

messages.content: Browser profile must be able to open new tabs using the tools

I'll read the current browser implementation before changing anything.## 1. Objective

- Let the shared browser open and manage **multiple tabs** through the existing browser tools (no new tool registration).
- Keep the user's live VNC view in sync: the tab the AI drives is always the tab brought to front.
- Never destroy the window: the last tab cannot be closed.
- Reuse the already-registered `browse_action` tool, so `tools/__init__.py` (1600+ lines) and the profile `tools` list stay untouched.

## 2. Information gathered

- `Browser` (`codx/junior/browser/browser.py`) holds `playwright`, `browser`, `context`, `page` and already re-selects the visible/focused page on `connect()` (`_select_active_page`). It has **no** tab API; every action targets the single `self.page`.
- `browse_action` (`codx/junior/tools/browser_tools.py`) is a plain `if/elif` dispatch on `action`, with `params` mirrored into the activity audit and one JSON schema (`BROWSE_ACTION_TOOL_JSON`, enum of actions).
- `codx/junior/browser/__init__.py` exports `Browser`/`BrowserManager`; the browser package imports **no** playwright at module level, so adding a light module is safe.
- Tests use plain `asyncio.run(...)` helpers (no `asyncio_mode` in `pyproject.toml`).
- Project convention: never rewrite a big file from memory; `browser.py` is 1563 lines, so the tab logic goes into its own module and `browser_tools.py` (894 lines, read in full) gets the dispatch entries.

## 3. Change proposal

New engine module `codx/junior/browser/tabs.py` operating on a connected `Browser`:

| Function | Behaviour |
|---|---|
| `open_pages(browser)` | `context.pages` (open, non-closed), else `RuntimeError` |
| `list_tabs(browser)` | `[{index, id, url, title, active, closed}]` |
| `open_tab(browser, url=None)` | new page → activate (`bring_to_front`) → `browser.navigate(url)` → index resolved afterwards |
| `switch_tab(browser, index=None)` | sets `browser.page`, focuses it, syncs `session.current_url/title` |
| `close_tab(browser, index=None)` | refuses the last tab, closes, activates `min(index, last)`, returns `closed_index/closed_url/title` |
| `format_tabs(tabs)` | text lines for the tool response, `*` marks the active tab |

Guard: `MAX_TABS = 20` (tabs are visible to the user in the live view).

## 4. Changes summary

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `codx/junior/browser/tabs.py` | **new** – tab primitives (list/open/switch/close/format) |
| `codx/junior/tools/browser_tools.py` | `browse_action` gains `tabs`, `new_tab`, `switch_tab`, `close_tab` + `index` argument, docstring, error hint and JSON schema |
| `codx/junior/profiles/browser.profile` | profile content: work with tabs instead of destroying the current page |
| `tests/browser/test_browser_tabs.py` | **new** – tab primitives with fake page/context/browser |

REST parity (`POST /api/browsers/{id}/action`) is intentionally **not** touched: it would require rewriting `codx/junior/api/browser.py`, which was not read in this session. Flag it as the next step if the UI needs a tab bar.

## 5. The changes

<file_change path="codx/junior/browser/tabs.py" language="python" change_type="new" encoding="text">
"""
Tab (page) management for the shared browser session.

The browser container is a real Chromium window: the user watches it through the
live VNC view while the AI drives it over CDP, so tabs are a **shared** resource.
Opening, selecting and closing them must be visible in that same window.

``Browser`` (``codx.junior.browser.browser``) owns the connection and the page
automation primitives; this module adds the tab primitives it deliberately does
not cover, operating on a connected ``Browser``:

    tabs = await list_tabs(browser)         # every tab + active flag
    tab  = await open_tab(browser, url)     # new tab, navigated and focused
    tab  = await switch_tab(browser, index) # move the AI (and the user) to it
    tab  = await close_tab(browser, index)  # close one, activate the next

Conventions
-----------
- the *tab index* is the position of the page in ``context.pages`` (stable while
  no tab is opened or closed); that is what the agent tools expose;
- ``browser.page`` always points at the tab the AI drives;
- every selection is brought to front, so the live view shows the tab the AI is
  working on (co-browsing);
- the last tab is never closed: closing it would close the browser window the
  user is watching.
"""

import logging
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

#: Hard cap on the tabs an agent may open (they are all visible to the user).
MAX_TABS = 20


def _session_label(browser) -> str:
    """Short session id used in the log lines (never raises)."""
    session = getattr(browser, "session", None)
    return str(getattr(session, "id", "") or "?")[:8]


def _is_closed(page) -> bool:
    """Return True when the page is already closed (never raises)."""
    try:
        return bool(page.is_closed())
    except Exception:
        return False


def open_pages(browser) -> List[Any]:
    """
    Return the open tabs of a connected browser.

    Args:
        browser: Connected :class:`Browser`.

    Returns:
        List[Any]: Playwright pages, in the browser's tab order.

    Raises:
        RuntimeError: When the browser is not connected.

    Example:
        >>> open_pages(browser)  # doctest: +SKIP
        [<Page url='https://example.com'>]
    """
    context = getattr(browser, "context", None)
    if context is None:
        raise RuntimeError("Browser not connected (call start_session first)")
    return [page for page in list(context.pages) if not _is_closed(page)]


def active_tab_index(browser, pages: Optional[List[Any]] = None) -> int:
    """
    Return the index of the tab the AI is driving.

    Args:
        browser: Connected :class:`Browser`.
        pages: Already resolved tab list (avoids a second lookup).

    Returns:
        int: Index in ``pages``, or -1 when there are no tabs.
    """
    pages = open_pages(browser) if pages is None else pages
    page = getattr(browser, "page", None)
    for index, candidate in enumerate(pages):
        if candidate is page:
            return index
    return len(pages) - 1 if pages else -1


async def describe_tab(browser, page, index: int) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Build the tab descriptor returned to the agent tools.

    Args:
        browser: Connected :class:`Browser` (used to flag the active tab).
        page: Playwright page.
        index: Position of the page in the tab list.

    Returns:
        Dict with ``index``, ``id``, ``url``, ``title``, ``active`` and ``closed``.
    """
    try:
        url = page.url or ""
    except Exception:
        url = ""
    try:
        title = (await page.title()) or ""
    except Exception:
        title = ""
    return {
        "index": index,
        "id": f"tab-{index}",
        "url": url or "about:blank",
        "title": title.strip(),
        "active": page is getattr(browser, "page", None),
        "closed": _is_closed(page),
    }


async def list_tabs(browser) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
    """
    Return every open tab; the one the AI drives carries ``active: True``.

    Args:
        browser: Connected :class:`Browser`.

    Returns:
        List[Dict[str, Any]]: One descriptor per tab, in tab order.

    Example:
        >>> await list_tabs(browser)  # doctest: +SKIP
        [{'index': 0, 'url': 'https://example.com', 'active': True, ...}]
    """
    pages = open_pages(browser)
    return [await describe_tab(browser, page, index) for index, page in enumerate(pages)]


async def _sync_location(browser, page) -> None:
    """
    Mirror the tab URL/title into the session (summaries, audit and UI read it).

    Kept out of ``Browser`` on purpose: tab handling must not depend on that
    class' private helpers.
    """
    session = getattr(browser, "session", None)
    if session is None:
        return
    try:
        session.current_url = page.url or session.current_url
    except Exception:
        pass
    try:
        session.current_title = await page.title()
    except Exception:
        pass
    try:
        session.mark_active()
    except Exception:
        pass


async def _activate(browser, page) -> None:
    """Make *page* the page the AI drives and the tab the user sees."""
    browser.page = page
    try:
        await page.bring_to_front()
    except Exception as ex:
        # Not fatal: the tab is still drivable, only the focus hint was lost.
        logger.debug("bring_to_front failed: %s", ex)
    await _sync_location(browser, page)


async def open_tab(browser, url: Optional[str] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Open a new tab, focus it and (optionally) navigate to *url*.

    The current tab is left untouched, so the agent can keep a reference page
    open while working on another one.

    Args:
        browser: Connected :class:`Browser`.
        url: Optional URL opened in the new tab (``file:///home/<project>/...``
            works for shared project folders).

    Returns:
        Dict[str, Any]: Descriptor of the new (now active) tab.

    Raises:
        RuntimeError: When the browser is not connected or :data:`MAX_TABS` is
            already reached.
        RuntimeError: When the navigation fails.
    """
    pages = open_pages(browser)
    if len(pages) >= MAX_TABS:
        raise RuntimeError(
            f"Too many open tabs ({len(pages)}); close one with close_tab first"
        )

    context = getattr(browser, "context", None)
    page = await context.new_page()
    await _activate(browser, page)
    if url:
        # navigate() keeps the networkidle -> load fallback and syncs the session
        await browser.navigate(url)

    index = active_tab_index(browser)
    logger.info(
        "Opened tab %s (%s) in session %s",
        index, url or "about:blank", _session_label(browser),
    )
    return await describe_tab(browser, page, index)


async def switch_tab(browser, index: Optional[int] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Make the tab at *index* the one the AI drives and the user sees.

    Args:
        browser: Connected :class:`Browser`.
        index: Tab index (0-based). ``None`` keeps the active tab.

    Returns:
        Dict[str, Any]: Descriptor of the selected tab.

    Raises:
        RuntimeError: When the browser is not connected or has no tabs.
        ValueError: When *index* is not a number or is out of range.
    """
    pages = open_pages(browser)
    if not pages:
        raise RuntimeError("The browser has no open tabs")

    if index is None:
        target = active_tab_index(browser, pages)
    else:
        try:
            target = int(index)
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            raise ValueError(f"tab index '{index}' is not a number")
    if target < 0 or target >= len(pages):
        raise ValueError(f"tab index {index} is out of range (0-{len(pages) - 1})")

    page = pages[target]
    await _activate(browser, page)
    logger.info("Switched to tab %s of session %s", target, _session_label(browser))
    return await describe_tab(browser, page, target)


async def close_tab(browser, index: Optional[int] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Close a tab and activate the one that takes its place.

    The last remaining tab is never closed: Chromium would close the window and
    the user would lose the live view.

    Args:
        browser: Connected :class:`Browser`.
        index: Tab index (0-based). ``None`` closes the active tab.

    Returns:
        Dict[str, Any]: Descriptor of the newly active tab plus ``closed_index``,
        ``closed_url`` and ``closed_title``.

    Raises:
        RuntimeError: When the browser is not connected, has no tabs, or only one
            tab is left.
        ValueError: When *index* is not a number or is out of range.
    """
    pages = open_pages(browser)
    if not pages:
        raise RuntimeError("The browser has no open tabs")
    if len(pages) <= 1:
        raise RuntimeError(
            "Cannot close the last tab: it would close the browser window the user "
            "is watching. Navigate it somewhere else or open another tab first"
        )

    else:
        try:
            target = int(index)
        except (TypeError, ValueError):

    if target < 0 or target >= len(pages):
        raise ValueError(f"tab index {index} is out of range (0-{len(pages) - 1})")

    remaining = open_pages(browser)

    next_index = min(target, len(remaining) - 1)

        "Closed tab %s of session %s (active tab: %s)",
        target, _session_label(browser), next_index,
    )

    result = await describe_tab(browser, remaining[next_index], next_index)
    result["closed_index"] = target
    result["closed_url"] = closed.get("url")
    result["closed_title"] = closed.get("title")
    return result


def format_tabs(tabs: List[Dict[str, Any]]) -> str:
    """
    Render tabs as one line each, marking the active tab with ``*``.

    Args:
        tabs: Descriptors returned by :func:`list_tabs`.

    Returns:
        str: Plain text listing (``*`` = tab the AI is driving).

    Example:
        >>> print(format_tabs([{"index": 0, "title": "A", "url": "https://a", "active": True}]))
        * [0] A — https://a
    """
    if not tabs:
        return "(no open tabs)"
    lines = []
    for tab in tabs:
        marker = "*" if tab.get("active") else "-"
        title = tab.get("title") or "(untitled)"
        lines.append(
            f"{marker} [{tab.get('index')}] {title} — {tab.get('url') or 'about:blank'}"
        )
    return "\n".join(lines)
